_about: The Radar's rulebook: the script rules the Mac engine and the phone share. check_fidelity.py, hook_lint.py and spoken_lint.py read it through rules.py on the Mac; the Anima app reads the same file to parse week files and to gate the scripts it writes itself. Change a value here, release, and both follow. Patterns are Python re syntax that ICU (Swift) also accepts; flags are separate: i = ignore case, m = multiline, s = dot matches newline.

script._about: check_fidelity.py length: spoken_hook plus script, split on whitespace. radar-config.json show.word_ceiling and show.words_per_second override per creator.

text_hook._about: hook_lint.py: the burned line a muted viewer reads in one fixation.

epigram._about: hook_lint.py FAIL: the two-sentence antithesis epigram, on every field a viewer receives.

epigram_button._about: check_fidelity.py FAIL on the button and takeaway lines.

neg_parallel._about: check_fidelity.py FAIL on the button and takeaway lines.

sincerity.pattern: \b(?:and\s+)?(?:honestly|frankly|truthfully|genuinely|to be fair|let'?s be real|i'?ll be honest|if i'?m honest|real talk)\b
sincerity._about: spoken_lint.py: a candour marker. HIGH when the rest of its sentence is an evaluation with no fact in it.

eval_copula._about: spoken_lint.py: the evaluation a candour marker must not be attached to.

gates._about: The human half of the gate, as text. SKILL.md carries the same words; tests/run.sh fails if they drift apart.
gates.two_question: Every script ships only if at least one is YES: is this entertaining IN the creator's niche, insider material an insider would grin at or feel seen by; does it teach something the viewer can run. Both is the sweet spot.
gates.vacuum_test: A cold scroller with zero context, sound off, one fixation, must instantly get what the video is about.
